content: Iesu Orot Iyawasai
Iesu oyau emon isur mom, ato sabu kuayo gagamin on On sigibubunuai sinai.
Namon orot usin gawud komasis emon ibikokosarai on inat Iesu aurin, nanai sindan irou ato iyau, “Bada, Om ungogoi mes on eigumidariu.”
Iesu iman iyotet igat orot usin iruyein. On iyafotai iyau, “Yau agogoi om ungumidar. “Egumidar!” Ra kaita orot usin gawud komasis emon on iyawas.

Namon Iesu on orot aurin iyau, “Om untatam! Men iyafan tani unkasonai mes, baise om totor unan priest aurin ato usim on ininateteai; namon om sirifu God aurin unyagai ato Moses an baifafaro dura iyau nanaba; onai sabu engon sinsagob on om ari ugumidar.”
Iesu on Rome Asi Wou Orot Gagamin an Agirotin Iyawasai
Iesu inat Capernaum mafam gagaminai irui mom, ato Rome yangan asi wou an orot gagamin on inat inefotai ato baibais mes On aurin ifefeyan iyau:
“Bada, yau au agirotin on isawau goai nan emama, on usibaban gagamin bag eboai ato men fofonin iniyayob on.”
Iesu iyau, “Yau arimon anan aniyawasai.”
Wou yangan asi orot gagamin iyafotai iyau, “Oh ambin, yau men obiu on anboem tanan au goai. Om asir dura wat unau ato au agirotin on arimon inyawas.

Yau mat on wou yangan asi babadis fani asi baibad babanai atatawar ato wou yangan fani on yau au baibad babanai semama, Yau wou orot tani awur, ‘Enai! ato on enan; a wou orot tani awur, ‘Enat!’ ato on enat; ato au agirotin awur, ‘Atonio bobo eiyamai!’ ato on bobo ebiyamai.”
Iesu atonio dura itatam mom on iduduran ato sabu On sibigibubunuai on auris iyau, “Yau awurem dura bag, Israel amonai on men iyafan tani an baitutum auman on nanaba agaturai on.
Yau awurem sabu sigaraba arimon wera matan emon a wera sifun emon sinnat Abraham, Isaac a Jacob mat sinamair safam an Baiaiwab amonai nan mat bayu sinam.
Baise osi sabu iyabon ainau Baiaiwab amonai sitmama on arimon sinrebetetis singat womanai sinar, osi arimon nan sinatou was sinitafoforen.”
Namon Iesu on wou yangan asi orot gagamin aurin iyau, “Om enai au go ato om mamaba ebitutum on arimon inmatar.” Ra kaita wou yangan asi orot gagamin an agirotin on iyawas.
Iesu Sabu Sigaraba Iyawasis
Iesu inai Peter an goai ato on nan Peter rawan jever isawau usin iforab ireai i’yen it.
Iesu iman iyof Peter rawan jever imanai ibo; ato usin ifoforab on isibu, jever imisir Iesu an bayu ibotitiwag wain.
Ibirabirabi ato sabu sigaraba osi iyabon dau tefasi simama on siboes sinat Iesu aurin. Iesu on duraiai wat i’yau on ayu komasis ifaitanis sigat ato osi sabu iyabon sisasawau on engon iyawasis.
On atonio bobo ifour itiyamai itidura bag mamaba aubairuruotin Isaiah i’yau on, “On Toun on ati sawau engon iboseseiren ato iboen inai isawar.”
Orot Ruam Sigogoi Iesu An Baigibubunuotis Sitmatar
Iesu isagob sabu kuayo on sinat sikufifinai on mes On an baigibubunuotis iyawures sitan kamit reban emon nan.
Baifafaro an baibebeotin tani inat Iesu aurin. On iyau, “Baibebeotim, yau abotitiwagiu Om efan menan menan unnanan on yau anigibubunuem.”
Iesu iyafotai iyau, “Rega kuke fox on asi dogu aumas, a kiwiu on asi batar aumas, baise Orot Natun on an efan ambin menan nan ininir inen a iniyarir.”
Orot tani, on min baigibubunuotin tani on iyau, “Bada, ainau on yau an matabir men anan au go tamau an garobai.”
Iesu iyafotai iyau, “Om Yau eigibubunueu, sabu iyabon ayubis sirabob semama, osi tous on turas rabobin singarob.”
Iesu Yabat Yawarad Iyawur Nurob Imatar
Iesu wayai ikaruge ato an baigibubunuotis mat sinai.
Ra kaita yabat kuyabobot gagamin kamitai isisin ato wa on kafakakai mom itdarir. Baise Iesu on iyenbubur.
Baigibubunuotis on Iesu aurin sinai ato sibaban imisir. Osi siyau, “Bada, eiyawasi, wei kafakakai mom wanarab!”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Omi aibo mes wobeber i? Omi ami baitutum on ikafakakai bag!” Namon On imisir dura wawaninai yabat a yawarad iyawures, ato nurob obin maiau imatar.
Baigibubunuotis engon tutufin siduduran. Osi siyau, “Atonio on abi orot? Yabat a yawarad mat min On fonan setatam!”
Iesu on Orot Ruam Dau auman Iyawasis

Iesu inat kamit reban emon, Gadara tafanam amonai nan, ato orot ruam on rasi dogu emon sigat On mat sinofoten. Osi sabu on dau tefasi simama ato osi unis sikomas kwakwan men iyafan tani fofonin on etai nan itabib on.
Osi ra kaita siyoku siyau, “Om God Natun, aifan aurin on wei egogoii? Om unat wei unimakiei weie an wera bag innat i?”
On efan bisinai nan on foro unis sigaraba sibitu.
On mes dau on Iesu sifefeyanai siyau, “Om wei unfafaitani on, uniyafarei wanan foro unis sigaraba on tefasi wanag.”
Iesu osi auris iyau, “Omi wonai,” on mes osi sinai foro tefasi sigai. Foro unis sigaraba on anag rerebanai siyayai sisur sinai kamitai siyamtotom.
Sabu ato foro sikakaifares on siyayai sinai mafam gagaminai sigat, nan bobo mamaba orot ruam a dau auris simamatar on sabu sikasones.
On mes sabu engon tutufin mafam gagamin emon on sinai Iesu sitnefotai mes; ato osi On sit mom on, sifefeyanai asi tafanam itikirir itgat mes.
